title: Express Knowledge Check
description: Check your understanding of Express routing, middleware, request parsing, validation, security middleware, error handling, and API structure.
author: DailyCoder

options.text: A function that runs during the request-response cycle

questions.explanation: Middleware can inspect, modify, end, or pass along requests and responses.

questions.prompt: Why should request bodies be validated before application logic uses them?

options.text: Clients can send malformed or unexpected data
All request bodies are trusted by default

questions.explanation: Validation protects route handlers from invalid inputs and makes error responses consistent.

questions.prompt: Which middleware category helps set safer HTTP response headers?
questions.explanation: Helmet and similar middleware set security-related headers for Express responses.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of centralized Express error handling middleware?

options.text: To turn thrown or forwarded errors into consistent responses

questions.explanation: A central error handler keeps response shape, logging, and status handling consistent.
